cwe_content.cwe: CWE-94,Improper Control of Generation of Code ('Code Injection')

candidate.Reason: Direct use of eval() on user-provided input can lead to code injection vulnerabilities as it allows execution of arbitrary Python code.
The function provides an unsafe path (when safe=False) that uses eval() on user-provided input, which is vulnerable to code injection.
Calling preprocess_input_exprs_arg_string with safe=False enables the unsafe eval() path, making the application vulnerable to code injection.
